notes.title: Current Development Status
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, everyone![/b]

First of all, I want to apologize for not keeping you as informed as you deserve. The main reason is that I currently have a full-time job, which means I haven’t been able to dedicate as much time as I’d like to the game’s development. However, I’ve been working hard during my free time and I’m excited to share some of the progress I’ve made over the past few weeks.

[b]Recent Improvements:[/b]

[olist]
[*]🔧 Performance improvements: The game now runs much more smoothly, with optimizations that provide a more stable experience.
[*]🧠 Improved AI for characters and bosses: Enemies are now smarter and more challenging, making battles even more thrilling.
[*]🌍 New levels: I’ve added new levels that significantly enhance the storyline and expand the game’s world.
[*]🎙️ Spanish voiceovers: We’ve added Spanish voiceovers for the characters and cutscenes, increasing the immersion.
[*]🎨 Graphic improvements: Visual adjustments have been made to elevate the graphical quality to a new level.
[*]🏆 13 levels completed: Development is progressing steadily, with 13 levels already finished and ready for the adventure.
[*]🔥 Many more changes that you’ll discover as you play.
[/olist]

[b]English Voiceovers:[/b]
I know many of you are eagerly awaiting the English localization, especially the voiceovers. English voiceovers will be coming in the future, but at the moment, I don’t have the budget necessary to implement them. I’m working on it and hope to have more news for you soon!

Thank you so much for your patience and continued support! The game is moving forward, and I can’t wait for you to enjoy it when it’s ready.

I'm leaving you with a short video to show some of the progress I've made in the game. I ran into a few technical issues while recording my screen with OBS, so the resolution isn't the best. However, you can expect higher quality videos in the future.

🚀 Hello Dark Zone Community! 🚀

We hope you're enjoying the latest demo update! Our goal is to make Dark Zone the best experience possible, and for that, we need your help!

If you come across any bugs, big or small, or if you have suggestions to make the game even more amazing, we want to hear from you! Your feedback is crucial to us.

Head over to the #feedback channel on Discord and share your thoughts. We're keeping an eye on every suggestion to make Dark Zone something everyone will love!

Thank you for being part of this incredible community! 🎮✨

notes.title: Dark Zone Demo
notes.notes:
Immerse yourself in the zombie apocalypse with our Steam demo! Face bloodthirsty hordes, uncover secrets on an epic journey. Are you ready to survive? 💀🔥🎮

I would also love to hear your feedback to improve the demo; it would mean a lot to me as it will help enhance the final version of the game.

Can you join my Discord channel? There we could discuss these topics and hear your feedback.
